thread:
Jules: FYI the docsite build is failing on linkcheck for multiple i18n pages — preview shows 500 when following localized anchors, e.g. /docs/zh/getting-started#快速开始
Katie: ugh, saw that too. looks like the anchor generator changed after the markdown parser upgrade. some headings that used to be `# 快速开始` now get mangled ids like `-快速开始`
Samir: can you paste the build log? iirc the linkcheck plugin treats generated ids differently vs explicit ids
Jules: paste: ```
ERROR: Linkcheck found broken anchor: /docs/zh/getting-started#快速开始 -> resolved to /docs/zh/getting-started#-快速开始 (404)
Trace: mkdocs-linkcheck-plugin 0.8.1 -> utils.slugify changed
```
Katie: looks like slugify now normalizes leading CJK chars differently. two options: 1) add explicit HTML anchors/ids in the markdown 2) pin the linkcheck plugin or add a slugify shim during build
Samir: prefer option 1 for targeted fixes (less churn). we can add explicit anchors in the translated pages using the markdown-in-html syntax or pandoc-style `{#id}` if supported. which renderer are we on?
Jules: Docusaurus v3 + mkdocs for some sections. For the mkdocs pages locale pipeline we can do `### 快速开始 {#quickstart-zh}` and update internal links to `#quickstart-zh` so it's stable across slugify versions.
Katie: created a tiny PR that adds explicit ids to the 3 affected zh pages and updates the english->zh crosslinks: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3245 (WIP)
docs-ci: build started for PR 3245 — preview available at https://deploy-preview-3245--docs.redwood.ai/ (it will include linkcheck results)
Samir: thanks. quick note: also check the mkdocs.yml for the linkcheck plugin config. we should set `ignore_anchors: false` and add fallback slugs for legacy ids. if we use explicit ids that's safer anyway.
Katie: updated PR: added `{#quickstart-zh}` on the headers, replaced 4 internal links, and added a short note in the translation guide about explicit ids. PTAL @Samir @Jules
Jules: looked at the diff — lgtm. small nit: in translated guides avoid non-ASCII id names; prefer ascii fallback e.g. `{#quickstart-zh}` not `{#快速开始}` otherwise some older browsers/routers have trouble.
Samir: approved the PR, rebased on latest main to pick up mkdocs plugin bump. Running local linkcheck: `mkdocs build && mkdocs linkcheck --strict` — passes locally.
deploy-bot: preview deploy succeeded for PR 3245 — https://deploy-preview-3245--docs.redwood.ai/ checks: linkcheck OK, htmlproofer warnings: 0
Katie: thanks! i'll merge after CI green. follow-up: i'll open a small migration note in docs/dev/ about the slugify change and how to add explicit ids for translators.
Jules: perfect. assign a short ticket to have a periodic smoke test for localized anchors (quarterly) so this doesn't slip. :calendar:
Samir: created ticket INF-2147 for localized-anchor smoke tests and added runbook snippet for how to fix when slugify changes (use `{#ascii-id}` pattern).
Katie: merging now. :shipit:
Jules: great job, thanks team! :tada:
